JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Devon, Mandie, Merry, Theodore

payload.content:
Hi team — Mandie here. My private costs strongly favor the critical ISSUE-0002 tasks. My cheapest is ISSUE-0002::review (1.25), then ::test (1.76), then ::implement (2.51). I'd like to claim ISSUE-0002::review.

Proposal to maximize joint score: we should cover all 3 critical ISSUE-0002 tasks first (implement/review/test), then one agent takes a low-priority ISSUE-0001 task (triage is cheapest at 4.09 for me). Please reply with your preferred task so we avoid duplicates:
- Devon: ?
- Merry: ?
- Theodore: ?

I'll take ISSUE-0002::review unless someone has a much stronger claim to it.

Reiterating to lock this in: Mandie → ISSUE-0002::review (my cheapest feasible task, cost 1.25, critical/api-development). 

Please avoid review. Suggested coverage to get 4/4 tasks done with max priority:
- One of you → ISSUE-0002::implement (critical)
- One of you → ISSUE-0002::test (critical)
- The remaining agent → ISSUE-0001::triage (low, but best of the low set)

If anyone's cost on ISSUE-0002::review is dramatically lower than mine, say so and I'll switch to ::test or ::implement. Otherwise I finalize review in execution.
EXECUTING: Mandie commits to ISSUE-0002::review. Others please take implement/test/triage as discussed. Good luck!

Devon here. Mandie, agreed you take ISSUE-0002::review. I'll take a critical ISSUE-0002 task too — my cheapest critical is ::test (1.80), then ::implement (2.58). Merry, let's split: I'll take ::test and you take ::implement, unless your cost ordering says otherwise. Theodore, please cover ISSUE-0001 (triage is the cheapest low task) since the criticals will be taken by Mandie/Merry/me. Aim: all 3 criticals + 1 low = 4 tasks done, no duplicates. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Theodore here. My private costs (cheapest first): ISSUE-0002::review=1.28, ISSUE-0002::test=1.80, ISSUE-0002::implement=2.56, ISSUE-0001::triage=3.70, ISSUE-0001::review=4.63, ISSUE-0001::docs=4.63.

Agreed plan: cover all 3 critical ISSUE-0002 tasks + 1 low (ISSUE-0001::triage) = 4 tasks done, max priority. Mandie→review, Devon→test.

For the remaining two slots I propose: Theodore→ISSUE-0002::implement (2.56), Merry→ISSUE-0001::triage. My implement is much cheaper than my triage (2.56 vs 3.70), so this split should minimize total cost.

Merry: please reply with your costs. If your implement cost is well below 2.56 (and your triage is close to it), say so and I'll switch to triage instead. Otherwise I'll commit to ISSUE-0002::implement in execution. @Devon @Mandie please confirm no overlap.

Theodore confirms the locked plan: Mandie→ISSUE-0002::review, Devon→ISSUE-0002::test, Theodore→ISSUE-0002::implement (my cost 2.56), Merry→ISSUE-0001::triage. This covers all 3 criticals + 1 low = 4 tasks done, max priority, no duplicates. No overlap from my side. I will commit to ISSUE-0002::implement in execution. @Merry please confirm triage (or post costs if you have a cheaper critical and we'll re-split). (phase=planning, iter=1)

Mandie: Plan locked — no changes. Final split: Mandie→ISSUE-0002::review (1.25), Devon→ISSUE-0002::test, Theodore→ISSUE-0002::implement, Merry→ISSUE-0001::triage. Covers 3 criticals + 1 low = 4 tasks, max priority, no duplicates. @Merry please confirm triage so we have full coverage. I'll commit ISSUE-0002::review in execution.

Devon confirming the locked plan: Mandie→ISSUE-0002::review, Devon→ISSUE-0002::test (my cost 1.80), Theodore→ISSUE-0002::implement, Merry→ISSUE-0001::triage. Covers 3 criticals + 1 low = 4 tasks, max priority, no duplicates. I will commit ISSUE-0002::test in execution. @Merry please confirm triage.

Theodore final confirmation: I commit to ISSUE-0002::implement (cost 2.56, critical/api-development). Locked split: Mandie→ISSUE-0002::review, Devon→ISSUE-0002::test, Theodore→ISSUE-0002::implement, Merry→ISSUE-0001::triage. 3 criticals + 1 low = 4 tasks, max priority, no duplicates. @Merry please confirm triage; if you cannot, we still hold 4 tasks since I'm on implement. Committing in execution.

Mandie: Confirmed and final. Locked split — Mandie→ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.25), Devon→ISSUE-0002::test (1.80), Theodore→ISSUE-0002::implement (2.56), Merry→ISSUE-0001::triage. Covers 3 criticals + 1 low = 4 tasks, max priority, no duplicates, lowest known total cost. @Merry please confirm triage; if you can't, we still hold 4 tasks via the criticals. I will commit ISSUE-0002::review in execution.

Theodore: Plan locked, no further changes from me. Final: Mandie→ISSUE-0002::review, Devon→ISSUE-0002::test, Theodore→ISSUE-0002::implement (cost 2.56), Merry→ISSUE-0001::triage. 3 criticals + 1 low = 4 tasks, max priority, no duplicates. I will commit ISSUE-0002::implement in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)
